purpose: Additional CIS adoption and distribution work; does not replace CORE-PLAN-001 or claim CIS import compatibility.

stories.title: Establish ownership, initial consumer and release identities
deliverables: Decision record for publication and compatibility
acceptance_criteria: Repository home, package IDs, assembly identities, namespaces, licence and release owner are recorded before publication.
The actual first consumer is named and its supported framework recorded; CIS is not assumed to be that consumer.
EnviormentsOptions spelling and the guide's indefinite compatibility commitment, including prereleases, have an explicit disposition before a public baseline is created.

stories.title: Define a reusable library module descriptor
acceptance_criteria: Descriptor identifies module, exact library and guidance versions, package IDs, frameworks, capabilities, examples, skills, contracts, provenance and hashes.
Library module descriptors remain data and do not discover or execute target-repository assemblies.
Unknown schemas, invalid paths and incompatible version/capability selections produce useful diagnostics before installation.
Module identity remains distinct from CIS CLI modules and from Cis.Abstractions.

stories.title: Package versioned logging guidance and reference examples
acceptance_criteria: All eight source examples, developer instructions and skill references identify the same exact tested candidate packages.
CIS packaging preserves supported dotfiles and portable skills in both tool and standalone distributions.
Examples consume candidate packages without source project references; full verification archives remain separate from the lightweight installed reference bundle.
Package acquisition supports the selected feed or offline source explicitly; absence never triggers a silent latest-version fallback.

stories.title: Extend managed reference installation without changing applications
acceptance_criteria: Existing .NET engineering examples still install and reconcile; logging references have a separate identity.
Dry-run, repeat initialization, opt-out, user-edited/unowned files, retired files, malformed manifests and unsafe paths are exercised.
Reference copying does not edit application packages or startup, run examples, restore packages or execute tests.
Installed reference files remain excluded from application classification and implementation evidence.
A mismatched installed library and guidance version is surfaced; local edits are preserved during updates.

stories.title: Author and qualify portable logging skills
deliverables: Versioned references and bounded task evaluations
acceptance_criteria: Triggers distinguish initial adoption, application instrumentation and delivery diagnosis; unrelated logging tasks do not automatically select the core.
Skills inspect installed version, host ownership, existing providers and framework before proposing changes; unsupported or missing versions produce a clear next action.
API snippets and commands compile/run against the matching candidate and link to tested examples rather than inventing a second implementation.
Evaluations cover clean stdout, filtered deferred work, exception ownership, scope isolation, loss/deadline reporting and version mismatch.
No skill claims passing tests, durable delivery or approval without corresponding evidence; strict skill validation and deterministic audit run before release.

stories.title: Connect library selection to CIS instructions and skill routing
acceptance_criteria: C# detection can offer reference material but does not establish application adoption of the library.
Explicit selection or package evidence identifies the applicable logging skill/version; no duplicate generic logging authority is generated.
CIS .github/skills integration and portable reference skills point to the same maintained source.
Generated guidance retains user-owned content and states the available package, examples and limitations.

stories.title: Qualify one consumer and reconcile existing diagnostic examples
acceptance_criteria: A clean synthetic consumer installs exact packages using the supplied instructions and runs the selected skill scenarios.
The comparison distinguishes reusable logging from test-only diagnostic journals, metrics, traces and evidence retention.
Any proposed migration of CIS or existing examples is separately scoped; the core does not automatically replace their observability systems.
Consumer runs prove stdout/stderr separation, one runtime owner, independent filters and bounded shutdown with actual results.

stories.title: Bind the CIS reference release to verified library bytes
acceptance_criteria: CIS release metadata records exact compatible library, guide, example, skill and schema versions plus hashes.
The source guide's complete core release gates remain required if adopted; passing CIS installation checks does not substitute for them.
Clean installed-CIS replay verifies guidance and example integrity, version mismatch handling and user-edit preservation.
Publish the already-verified assets through the chosen release process, retaining older versioned guidance and historical core baselines.
